title: Manuel Azuares to the Carlist Secretary of State, London, 8 Sep 1837 (AHN Diversos-Colecciones 161 N.2): one table validated by our protocol, read in part

steps.what: Tables K3 and K5 learnt on views 03 and 05; one measurement on view 12 (designated and hashed beforehand): 0.198 vs 0.198.
Amendment 01: passages of views 04, 06-11 transcribed and hashed before decoding; for five passages a table learnt on the first half only and frozen.

One measurement per passage on its held-out half, reference = best of 1,000 shuffled tables (0.508): P063 M5 0.882, margin 0.374, validated; P062, P081, P092, P112 negative (held-out halves of 51-71 units).
Read by sense: 361 cipher words, 70 certain (verified table T6), 215 probable, 67 restored, 9 unresolved (78.9% without restorations).

outcome.method_basis: Tables recovered here by annealing on the cipher, with the clear words of the letter as context only; one of five passage tables (T6) validated by a pre-registered measurement on held-out lines. Key 'partial': K3, K5, T8, T9 not validated, indicator and digit groups not resolved.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule (certain + probable; restored words not counted), counted by hand on decryption.txt: 361 cipher words, 70 certain, 215 probable, 67 restored, 9 unresolved = 285/361 = 78.9%.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): transcription, tables and measuring script frozen by SHA-256 before any held-out line was decoded; one measurement per passage, corrected for multiple comparisons (reference = best of 1,000 shuffled tables, 0.508). P063 validated (M5 0.882, margin 0.374); four other passages negative; first protocol on view 12 negative. Verdict weak overall: pass for table T6 (P063) only, fail for the four other passages; only table T6 is verified.

texts.label: letter no. 780, views 03-12: cipher runs in a clear letter
texts.summary: Azuares reports talks with the Austrian chargé d'affaires in London: Austria and Britain contemplate making Maria II an absolute queen and reviving the old Portuguese Cortes, with General Goblet guiding Prince Ferdinand, at the cost of Dom Miguel's rights; Lisbon would treat with Don Carlos once he reached Madrid; Azuares objects that this would recognise the usurpation.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 9 Nov 2026 by one AI reader, reviewed before publication (words absent from the cipher removed, doubtful words moved to unresolved, certain limited to the verified table). The cipher words construe as Spanish sentences inside the clear letter: 70 certain, 215 probable, 67 restored, 9 unresolved of 361 (78.9% without restorations), so read in part.

outcome.notes: Only column T6_verified of key.tsv is validated (CC BY 4.0); the other tables are given as found, not validated. No image of the AHN/PARES letter is included (licence not found).

prior.where: No decipherment on the leaves; PARES describes the letter as partly in cipher but gives no decipherment; catalogue 2421 open, no key held; no target, issue or PR for Azuares, 2421 or Carlist ciphers on origin/main (GitHub API, 9 Nov 2026); no edition found in the vetting searches.

human: Brice Dudout chose the target and set the rules (held-out sets, thresholds and the measuring script frozen before decoding, one measurement each). AI agents transcribed, learned the tables, measured, read and wrote up. No human checked the transcription or the reading.
